dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid, symmetrical narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward a pointed posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins displaying continuous convex curvature without visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light blue-grey tone indicating a high-intensity median pixel value consistent with a late-subadult or mature white phenotype.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; the dorsal surface displays a largely homogeneous textural phase with minimal dark-pixel clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One prominent high-contrast circular aperture (blowhole) at the anterior end; one secondary small dark point-contrast mark on the left dorsal flank.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A sharp, linear topological ridge along the posterior central axis, creating a distinct shadow-casting geometric disruption.

other_distinctive_markers: A pronounced linear shadow-cast along the posterior dorsal ridge, highlighting the sharp elevation of the central axis relative to the lateral flanks.
